content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (tools/read_format) that loads a NOAA DEM netCDF file and extracts a FUNWAVE bathymetry subgrid. First half is a generic netCDF reader credited to Christian Stranne, 2011-04-02 (header box L3-11; purpose comment L13-19: ncdump-like listing missing from MATLAB): opens 'virginia_beach_13_mhw_2007.nc' read-only (nc_filename @L23, netcdf.open @L25), queries dims/vars (netcdf.inq @L29), then for each variable prints its name and all attributes (netcdf.inqVar @L37, inqAttName/getAtt @L41-42, disp @L43), captures add_offset/scale_factor when present (offset @L45, scale @L48, flag @L49) and evals the variable into the workspace, applying double(var)*scale+offset when scaled (@L55) else plain double (@L57). Second half (FUNWAVE-specific): dep=Band1' @L64 (GDAL-style netCDF band variable transposed), decimated preview pcolor every sk=10 points with demcmap (@L65-70); crops indices mst=1,men=6500,nst=2000,nen=8000 (@L72-75) into dep1/lat1/lon1 (@L77-79); saves ASCII dep_median.txt, lat_median.txt, lon_median.txt (@L81-83); plots the cropped grid at full resolution (figure @L85, sk=1 @L86, pcolor/demcmap/labels @L87-91).
entities: script (no functions); variables: nc_filename @L23, ncid @L25, numdims/numvars/numglobalatts/unlimdimID @L29, i (loop) @L36, varname/xtype/dimids/numatts @L37, flag @L39, j (loop) @L40, attname1 @L41, attname2 @L42, offset @L45, scale @L48, eval-created netCDF variables (incl. Band1, lat, lon) @L55/@L57, dep @L64, sk @L65 (reset @L86), mst @L72, men @L73, nst @L74, nen @L75, dep1 @L77, lat1 @L78, lon1 @L79

equations.ref: transpose netCDF band to row=lat orientation

io.name: netcdf.open @L25, netcdf.inq @L29, netcdf.inqVar @L37, netcdf.inqAttName @L41, netcdf.getAtt @L42, netcdf.getVar via eval @L55,@L57
pcolor decimated @L66 and cropped @L87, demcmap @L67,@L88, labels @L69-70,@L90-91, figure @L85

unresolved: the netCDF file is never closed (no netcdf.close after L25)

offset/scale persist across variables in the loop: flag resets @L39 each variable but offset does not — a variable with scale_factor and no add_offset would reuse a previous variable's offset in the eval @L55; latent cross-line defect L39-55, whether it occurs depends on the file's attributes
strmatch @L44,@L47 matches attribute-name prefixes and is deprecated; attributes like 'scale_factor_x' would false-positive — file-dependent

dep=Band1' @L64 assumes the file exposes variable 'Band1' (GDAL netCDF convention) plus lat/lon vectors — true for this NOAA DEM but not general; crop indices 2000:8000 / 1:6500 are case-specific with no provenance comment; script name says 'median' outputs (dep_median.txt) without explanation
duplicate 'clear all' @L1 and @L21 — remnant of concatenating the Stranne reader with the FUNWAVE-specific tail
